prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Beijing for a couple days, and I remember we kept talking about how parking there is its own little adventure.
Around that same time, my coworker was commuting between Beijing and Shanghai a lot, so those two cities were basically the whole travel storyline.
Then later in the year when I visited friends in Shenzhen, we ended up checking what movies were on in the city just to kill time.
Oh, and in Beijing we also did the super touristy thing—people kept swapping notes on attractions like it was a checklist.
One evening we actually parked at Sanlitun SOHO Parking, and I still remember the start time was 2025-03-25 17:00 because we were rushing from work.
We left the car there for 6 hours, and the license plate on the receipt was 苏F89012, which I joked looked like a random password.
The funny part is the driver contact they wrote down was 13833445566, and we double-checked it like three times just in case.
For that Beijing-to-Shanghai hop, my friend had already gotten flight MU5678 on 2025-04-18, under Aiden Miller, and it was with China Eastern.

And the same trip had these random tickets sorted out too—Forbidden City for 2025-03-16 in the morning, visitor name Xie Peng, 4 tickets; plus in Shenzhen they watched Kung Fu Panda 4 at Broadway Cinema Futian, 09:30, 4 seats, buyer name Huang Tao.
